notes: Sporeling Bloom Reactor, 4x4: a brown, root-veined basin round a flower that blooms around a glowing amber core: eight cream-and-pink petals that open and close on the 4-frame loop, spore specks drifting up. Off: the bloom is a closed bud over a dark core. Damaged: two petals torn and drooping, the basin cracked and weeping, the core stuttering. Disabled: withered brown petals, a dead dry core, the basin split.
